'''Malyssa Raventhorn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and the mistress of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mulchive Wermis]] during his time as [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. After Wermis's [[Death/Legends|death]], which was due to a fatal [[Heart/Legends|heart]] attack caused by an [[Liberation of the Besh Gorgon system|attack]] on the Imperials on the Wheel by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Raventhorn disappeared.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]], Malyssa Raventhorn lived during the reign of both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its successor, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in which the Empire fought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], she worked as a thief, and was the only [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tutti Snibit]] apprehended. He was, however, so distracted by [[Cambrian wine]] and conversation with Raventhorn that he passed out, which allowed her to escape. Later, she became the mistress of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mulchive Wermis]], a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Whilst Raventhorn was with Wermis, he was transferred from being captain of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] known as [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] to station duty aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. Wermis brought Raventhorn with him to the station and served as its [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], growing obese and sedentary in the posting and secretly claiming a small portion of the profits for himself instead of delivering them to the Empire.<ref name="VSV" />

Wermis's time as administrator ended when the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]], where the Wheel was located, was [[Liberation of the Besh Gorgon system|liberated]] by the newly formed New Republic, an event that caused Wermis to have a [[Death/Legends|fatal]] [[Heart/Legends|heart]] attack. On the same day as her lover's death, Raventhorn, as well as all of Wermis's stolen [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], vanished without a trace.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malyssa Raventhorn was first mentioned in the article ''[[The Not-So Magnificent Seven]]'' written by [[Greg Mitchell]]. Her backstory was later elaborated on in the second entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]].
